conditions: The import declaration uses a valid import set and satisfies each form's identifier constraints.
limitations: This describes bindings made available by a library import. Filesystem loading, REPL permissions, overlapping imports, and other report editions have separate rules.

triggers: Exact publisher representation changed, source correction, or contrary language or edition evidence.

statement: The July 2013 R7RS-small report lets an import set name a library or transform another import set. Its only and except forms select or exclude listed identifiers, and prefix and rename change their imported names.
